subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer the single enabled/configured account after channel selection, or should OpenClaw keep requiring explicit account selection when the default account is disabled?
rationale: The request changes a documented fallback/default path for outbound delivery, so maintainers should explicitly accept the compatibility policy before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Accept shared resolver policy
options.body: Review and land a shared resolver that prefers explicit/default/bound accounts first, then an enabled configured default, then exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Document or doctor the need for `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the default account is disabled and close or narrow the linked PR.

options.title: Require a channel-owned fix
options.body: Ask for a WhatsApp-only or plugin-owned adjustment if maintainers do not want core to own this fallback policy across channels.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Review and land a shared resolver that prefers explicit/default/bound accounts first, then an enabled configured default, then exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior review direction and has recent history around the shared outbound/channel account docs and helpers touched by this decision.
